title: Reasoning-to-Defend: Safety-Aware Reasoning Can Defend Large Language Models from Jailbreaking
reasoning: The paper focuses on defensive mechanisms against jailbreaking attacks and LLM safety. While the model's generated reasoning logs (CoT) occasionally reference actions as being 'morally wrong' or discuss 'ethical hacking' in its examples, the paper's core objective and benchmarking are focused on technical safety-alignment and robustness against adversarial prompts rather than the evaluation of ethical frameworks, religious values, or moral reasoning systems.
